extraction.notes: Column: three months ended 9/30/2026 (first column of S-8). Company reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Starting line is net income (loss) available to common shareholders, as printed. FFO check: 123,328 + adjustments = 16,171; Core check: 16,171 + adjustments = 21,839. Per-share check: 16,228 / 19,660 = 0.83 (FFO diluted incl. Series D distributions); 21,896 / 19,660 = 1.11 (Core). Categorization judgments: 'Loss on sale of non real estate assets' (174) in the FFO section tagged nareit_other, and the same line in Core tagged 'other'; 'Legal and other costs related to strategic review' tagged legal; 'Other miscellaneous items' (consists of (gain) loss on investments and interest rate swap amortization) tagged investment_gain_loss. Recurring capex: no AFFO section exists; the only disclosure on S-15 is Same-Store Total Recurring Capital Expenditures per Apartment Home of $452 for the quarter, which is a per-unit dollar figure, not a company total in thousands, so it was not recorded as an amount.
